name: Eggplant Parmigiana
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Brush the eggplant slices with most of the olive oil, spread them over two oven trays and roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until golden and collapsing.
Meanwhile, warm the remaining oil in a saucepan and cook the garlic for a minute, then add the passata. Simmer for 15 minutes until thickened, and season.
Stir half the basil through the sauce.
Spoon a little sauce into a baking dish, then layer eggplant, sauce, mozzarella and parmesan, repeating until everything is used and finishing with parmesan.
Bake for 30 minutes, until bubbling and browned at the edges.
Rest for 10 minutes so it sets enough to cut, then scatter with the remaining basil.
